title: Jack Teagarden as a flexible trombonist and mechanic
summary: Teagarden was very flexible and made his own mouthpieces and mutes.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Uh-huh. What do you think of Teagarden? How do you -- ?
Teagarden to me is one of the most flexible trombone players in the business. I have to put it that way.
Oh, yes, he can make his own. He made his own mouthpieces. He made his own mutes. You know, he was a mechanic, too, like --
Yes, he carried his lathe with him.
